title: How Well Do Prior-Data Fitted Networks Amortize Bayesian Inference?
abstract: arXiv:2610.13764v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) are trained to approximate the Bayesian posterior predictive distribution (PPD) of a synthetic prior, yet results about the approximation quality are surprisingly thin. Taking an empirical risk minimization perspective, we decompose the deployment error of PFNs into prior, context, and amortization error, and measure the latter against a reference PPD under a realistic prior. Results show that PFNs generally recover the targeted PPD very well. Nevertheless, we find that parts of the residual amortization error persist, especially in \textit{rare} settings under the prior pretraining distribution, even when scaling the model size, which manifests in disagreement between independently pretrained PFNs and leaves uncertainty about the predictor at inference time. translated_title: 先验数据拟合网络能多好地摊销贝叶斯推断？
translated_abstract: 先验数据拟合网络（PFNs）被训练用于近似合成先验的贝叶斯后验预测分布（PPD），然而关于其近似质量的研究结果却出人意料地稀少。从经验风险最小化的视角出发，我们将PFNs的部署误差分解为先验误差、上下文误差和摊销误差，并在现实先验下相对于参考后验预测分布来度量摊销误差。结果表明，PFNs通常能很好地恢复目标后验预测分布。然而，我们发现部分残余摊销误差仍然存在，尤其是在先验预训练分布中的罕见设置下，即使扩大模型规模也无法消除，这表现为独立预训练的PFNs之间的分歧，并在推理时给预测器留下不确定性。作为补救措施，我们研究了多种类型的贝叶斯模型平均方法，发现这些方法能够持续减少这种不确定性并改善预测性能。
tldr: 本文将先验数据拟合网络（PFNs）的部署误差分解为先验、上下文和摊销误差，发现PFNs虽能很好地恢复目标后验预测分布，但在罕见设置下仍存在残余摊销误差，而贝叶斯模型平均方法可有效减少这种不确定性并提升预测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper decomposes PFN deployment error into prior, context, and amortization errors, showing that while PFNs generally recover the target posterior predictive distribution well, residual amortization error persists in rare settings even with model scaling, and Bayesian model averaging can consistently reduce this uncertainty and improve prediction.
